svg.title: Slash And Logic Guards
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 11 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Slash ligatures improve comments and logic while protecting URLs and regexes.
斜线连字改善注释和逻辑符号，同时保护 URL 和正则。

g.text: // / /// 必须后接普通空格才触发。
/* / */ are block-comment boundaries, not glob-star helpers.
/* / */ 是块注释边界，不是 glob-star 辅助符号。
/\ / \/ require ordinary spaces on both sides.
/\ / \/ 必须左右都有普通空格才触发。
